SELECT d.makername, d.modnum, t.pollratehz, t.inplagms, t.resptimems, i.joyprec, i.driftres, i.trigres, i.hapstr
FROM testsessions t
JOIN deviceidentity d ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
JOIN interactionandcontrol i ON d.devregistry = i.interactdevref
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    d.makername AS manufacturer,
    d.modnum AS model,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (t.pollratehz::numeric / 100.0) * (1.0 - (t.inplagms + t.resptimems) / 30.0) * 10.0 
    AS numeric), 2) AS irs_score,
    i.joyprec,
    i.driftres,
    i.trigres,
    i.hapstr,
    CASE WHEN 
        ((t.pollratehz::numeric / 100.0) * (1.0 - (t.inplagms + t.resptimems) / 30.0) * 10.0) > 8.0
        AND i.joyprec > 9.0
        AND i.driftres > 9.5
        AND i.trigres >= 5
        AND i.hapstr > 8

FROM testsessions t
JOIN deviceidentity d ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
JOIN interactionandcontrol i ON d.devregistry = i.interactdevref
